title: Timber Blood Episode 1
last_recap: A thunderous shout splits sunrise; Kaan storms the timber yard, breath visible, bark splinters, villagers stare, hearts racing. The tax collector's ledger slams down, ink dripping like blood, Kaan's sister clutches a newborn, fear tightening. Night falls, Kaan returns to the log cabin, moonlight glinting on axe, wind howls through pine, resolve deepening. A sudden knock rattles the door; the landowner's emissary arrives, demanding timber quotas, Kaan's fists clench in fury.
